messages.Você traz seu agente. A Unitize cuida da: Bring your agent. Unitize handles operations.
messages.Estamos construindo uma camada operacion: We are building an operations layer for software houses and integrators to run agents with pinned versions, limits and project history.
messages.Uma interface para acompanhar o trabalho: One interface to follow the work. A runtime to execute it. A history to understand what happened.
messages.Um fluxo simples entre o seu código e um: A simple path from your code to traceable operations. Initial support is being developed with our own demo agent.
messages.Um convite para software houses e integr: An invitation to software houses and integrators in Brazil to discuss agent operations and take part in early pilots.
messages.Fluxo ilustrativo · sem execução nesta p: Illustrative flow · no execution on this page
messages.Cada entrega tem seu contexto. A base lo: Each delivery has its own context. The local prototype organizes runs by project, with administrator, operator or viewer access.
messages.O pedido é validado antes de entrar na f: Requests are validated before queuing. Pending-work limits help control load while keeping run status visible.
messages.O worker reserva o pedido e executa a ve: The worker claims a request and runs the selected version. The Docker demo uses a pinned image ID and resource limits.
messages.Consulte o que entrou, o que saiu e os e: Inspect inputs, outputs and recorded events. Review queue wait and processing time, and export a run as JSON.
messages.Execução local Python e Docker de demons: Local Python and demo Docker execution, project history and initial access controls.
messages.Integração de agentes de clientes, login: Customer-agent integration, production sign-in and budget policies. Pilots will open as technical validation progresses.
messages.Empacote o agente e defina seu contrato: Package the agent and define its input and output contract. The goal is to preserve your code and framework.
messages.Associe a execução a um projeto e escolh: Assign the run to a project and choose who can operate it. Establish limits before accepting new requests.
Inspect the queue, status and events. Cancel requests that have not started and review processing time.
messages.Use o histórico e o JSON exportado para: Use history and exported JSON to investigate failures and discuss the next version with your team.
messages.Organize a operação dos agentes que você: Organize operations for the agents you deliver. Separate projects, pin versions and find each run’s history.
messages.Uma base operacional para conectar entre: An operations foundation for deliveries built with different tools, without building a new dashboard for every pilot.
messages.Uma referência comum para quem desenvolv: A shared reference for development and operations teams: permissions, queues and processing records.
messages.Da primeira demonstração à operação de c: From the first demo to customer operations, with clear steps.
messages.Não prometemos execução de qualquer códi: This phase does not promise arbitrary-code execution or production isolation. The offering will expand through controlled pilots.
messages.Quero receber novidades e convites para: I want to receive Unitize updates and pilot invitations.
messages.Inscrição gratuita. Não cria uma conta n: Free registration. It does not create an account or guarantee an access date.
messages.Coletamos seu e-mail e a data da inscriç: We collect your email and registration date to organize the interest list. In this version, registration is stored in Unitize’s local database and no email is sent automatically.
messages.Operação de agentes em construção. Feita: Agent operations in development. Built with attention to every run.
A home port for your agents.
We are preparing the next step.
messages.Acompanhe a evolução da Unitize. As insc: Follow Unitize’s progress. Registration for updates and future pilots will open when sign-up is available.
messages.Por enquanto, conheça a proposta, a arqu: For now, explore our proposal, architecture and the path we are building.
messages.Esta versão não recebe e-mails nem reali: This version does not collect email addresses or accept registrations.
messages.Esta é uma apresentação pública e tempor: This is a temporary public introduction to Unitize. The platform and interest registration are still in development.
messages.Uma camada operacional para agentes de d: An operations layer for agents from different ecosystems.
